changed: Oblada is now built with the optimizations Chrome is built with, tuned on how the browser really runs: web pages and apps respond faster, scoring about 40% higher on the Speedometer benchmark. Oblada also takes about 200 MB less on disk, and 25 MB less to download.
fixed: Oblada no longer crashes when a tab opened as it starts, such as a link that opened Oblada, goes to another page.
